_comment: Inputs for scripts/gen_model.py. Body axes: x forward, y left, z up; origin at the CAD origin (frame centre). Re-run gen_model.py after editing.

frame._source: ROS/EMSD cad/mass_properties.json (QAV-RXL2 CAD; frame, arms, motors, Pi, FC, ESC and wiring)
frame._cad_to_body: The real front is CAD -y, so body = CAD rotated +90 deg about z (confirmed by the team 2026-11-08)

battery._source: Team measurement 2026-11-08 (6S 12000 mAh). Mass to be re-measured; 1.58 kg also quoted.
battery._mount: on top of the frame, long side front to back

motors._source_layout: Motor positions from EMSD drone.json, rotated to body axes. Spin from companion/README.md (verified 2026-10-26). Outputs from FC log 00016 (SERVO1..4_FUNCTION = 36,33,34,35).
motors._source_curve: ROS/EMSD motor_data.xlsx (sheet MQ1053B_6s_StepsTest_thrust_1_r, DShot300, ~24.7 V); fits in sim/README.md
motors._speed_map: rad/s = speed_per_cmd * (cmd + speed_offset), cmd = (PWM-1000)/1000; linear fit of the DC-motor model over cmd 0.15-0.95
motors._max_torque: null = real hardware, no current limit: full output reaches ~2320 rad/s, ~3.8 kgf, ~60 A (extrapolated beyond the bench test's top point of 2.0 kgf / 34.5 A at DShot 1500). The team limits current in firmware with MOT_SPIN_MAX (config/planned_changes.parm). A number here caps motor torque in the model instead (0.289 = 2.0 kgf).
motors._time_constant: assumed (not resolved by the bench test); typical for 8 inch props

payloads.name: water_module
payloads._source: config/payloads/water_module.urdf, from branch manan commit 33f060d (2026-11-15): 20 parts, 482 g, mass properties from STEP normalised to the measured mass. Its meshes are not on GitHub, so the model shows a box.
payloads._mount: Team 2026-11-15: centred under the frame, long side (module y, 186 mm) side to side, so no rotation.
payloads._top_z: ASSUMED: module top face height in its own axes = CoM z (-4.95 mm) + half the equivalent box height (47.5 mm). Check against the CAD.
payloads._box_size: solid box with the module's mass and principal inertias (body axes), used for collision and display

loads.name: water
loads._mass: Team 2026-11-15: up to 500 ml in flight. Override per run: gen_model.py --load water=0 (empty) or =0.25 etc.
loads._fill: Team: approximate the water as filling the bottom half of the module's box. That block (96 x 186 x 47.5 mm) holds ~848 ml, more than 500 ml, so the 500 g is spread over it (centre of mass and inertia approximate). Rigidly attached for now; sloshing is not modelled yet.

aero._comment: Blade-element constants for Gazebo's LiftDrag system; gen_model.py sizes blade area and drag to hit thrust_coeff and torque_coeff.
